title: Custom Soccer Ball Cleats Personalized Comforter Set, Machine Washable
description:
Transform your child's room with the Jeminise Soccer Player Comforter Set, perfect for young soccer enthusiasts. This bedding set, designed to inspire dreams of the pitch, combines comfort with a passion for the game, making it an ideal gift for any soccer fan.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed for young soccer fans, inspiring them to chase their dreams.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Uses environmental protection techniques for dye retention and fade prevention, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Included Components: This set includes one duvet cover.
  • Custom Options: Personalization options may include text input.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Style Modern
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 360
